front: Practice vs Mock in Interview Mode?
back: Practice: pause any time, free hints, deep-dive questions on demand. Mock: no pause, wall-clock timer, each hint costs 1 rubric point.
Requirements 5, Estimation 5, API 5, Data Model 5, High-Level Design 10, Deep Dives 10, Wrap-up 5.

front: When do deep-dive questions arrive in a 45-minute Mock?
back: Spread evenly over minutes 30–40 (4 questions: at 15:00, 12:30, 10:00, 7:30 remaining), or earlier if you open Deep Dives early.

front: What happens when the Mock clock reaches zero?
back: It keeps counting as time over (+mm:ss) and flags Over time. Nothing submits for you.
max(0, points − hint penalty) ÷ (2 × criteria). The penalty is hints used in Mock; Practice has none.

front: The three rules of honest self-scoring?
back: Evidence or zero; read the 2-point text first and step down; when torn, take the lower score.

front: What does the Run comparison show?
back: Your design and the reference run at the case's peak: worst p99, successful QPS, error rate, SPOFs, availability, cost and run challenge pass/fail. ▲ marks a metric over 5% worse.

front: Your design differs from the reference. Score it low?
back: No. Score against the rubric descriptions; use the Run comparison to catch real problems such as SPOFs or a failed run challenge.

front: Four reasons to interrupt a candidate in a peer mock?
back: More than 2 minutes over a step's budget, a number with no derivation, out-of-scope design, or about a minute of silence.

front: Interviewer sees a wrong but recoverable direction. What now?
back: Wait about a minute, then ask a question that exposes the problem. Whether the candidate recovers is the signal. Never teach mid-interview.
Evidence, impact, suggestion; at most two strengths and two gaps.

front: What does "▲ 25 pts" mean on the dashboard interview trend?
back: The latest attempt at that case scored 25 percentage points higher than the first one (not the previous one, not an average).

front: Why is a re-mock of the same case a weak signal?
back: You have read its reference, so the score partly measures memory. Confirm progress on a different case with the same pattern.

front: The first six cases to mock, in order?
back: URL shortener, rate limiter service, ticket booking, notification system, news feed, payment system.
Small domains mean the mock measures method (timing, estimates, signposting), not domain knowledge you have not met yet.

front: Which of the first six covers multi-region?
back: The rate limiter service: local counting with a one-second exchange of counts, merged like a G-counter.
